1) we formalize a class of human in the loop decision making problems in interactive environments, where multiple forms of advice are available to the learner; 2) we describe a learning algorithm that first learns to interprets advice and then learns from advice; 3) our algorithm can acquire new skills in puzzle-solving, navigation and locomotion domains with significantly less human intervention than reinforcement learning algorithms and less than imitation learning algorithms.
